entries.title: C0056 has separate spectral and GOE obligations
entries.statement: The 2018 Bourgade survey studies the Anderson operator Delta + lambda V on Z^d, with iid centered variance-one site potentials. In dimension three at weak disorder it identifies two distinct open-at-publication questions: existence of absolutely continuous spectrum for the infinite-volume operator, and GOE microscopic eigenvalue statistics for periodic finite-volume restrictions. The survey does not prove either implication, and its 2018 open label is not a current-status certificate. The C0056 intake combined the two goals in one row.
assumptions: Delta is the nearest-neighbor hopping operator with free spectrum [-2d,2d]

entries.title: 2026 preprint claims the C0056 AC branch for uniform sites
entries.statement: An OpenAI preprint dated 2026-09-23 claims that for every fixed d >= 3 there is lambda_d > 0 and a nonempty open interval I_d independent of lambda such that, for each fixed 0 < lambda < lambda_d, the nearest-neighbor Anderson operator on Z^d with iid uniform[-1,1] site potentials almost surely has nonzero, purely absolutely continuous spectrum on I_d. In d=3 its stated interval is (-6+e_2/2,-6+e_2), where 0 < e_2 < 1/100. This card records the authors' claim and theorem scope, not an independent proof verification. The preprint does not state a GOE local-statistics result.
assumptions: Authors' theorem statement inspected; mathematical proof not independently checked by w485
Probability-one event may depend on each fixed lambda

source.revision: main as read 2026-10-10; verify commit before publication

entries.title: GOE local statistics is the separate C0056 finite-volume target
entries.statement: For the same weak-disorder three-dimensional Anderson operator, Bourgade's 2018 survey expects GOE microscopic bulk eigenvalue statistics for periodic finite-volume restrictions. This is a finite-volume level-correlation question. Neither existence nor purity of infinite-volume absolutely continuous spectrum alone supplies a GOE limit. The exact energy, unfolding convention, law class, and limiting point-process formulation must be fixed before a theorem claim. Current status of this branch is not certified by the 2018 survey or by the 2026 AC preprint.
assumptions: Historical 2018 research expectation, not a theorem
Finite-volume restrictions use periodic boundary conditions

relations.rationale: The existing C0056 card combines the AC and GOE targets; this concept records their exact source distinction and dated status.
The 2026 author claim addresses the infinite-volume AC branch only, for iid uniform sites.
The finite-volume GOE branch is the second question explicitly separated in Bourgade Section 2.1.
